notes: Mid-market billing SaaS. Primary interest: hosted API as quick win, pilot with chat support agents, then move to Dedicated for predictable latency/cost. Use-case: support reps and automated agent handling subscription/billing workflows (Stripe/Zuora). Key asks: streaming + tool-calling (invoke Stripe/Zuora APIs via tool calls), deterministic structured JSON outputs for downstream ingestion, JSON schema validation, audit logs. Latency SLO: p95 <= 250ms for streaming turn-by-turn; prefer p95 <= 150ms for critical flows. Want tool-calling examples and sample structured outputs (refund/create-invoice) in demo. Cost-sensitive but values latency and predictable throughput. Quote from VP Product: "If we can't guarantee sub-250ms p95 in streaming mode, automated flows will increase handle time and we lose efficiency." Security: must support SSO (SAML), KMS integration for keys, SOC2 and ISO interest, data residency for EU customers. Evaluating hosted API first to validate integration and runtime behavior; timeline to Dedicated if POC meets latency and cost targets.
